# National Park Service

> > Official website of the U.S. National Park Service, preserving America's natural and cultural heritage across 400+ parks and historical sites.

NPS.gov serves as the primary digital gateway to America's national parks, monuments, and historical sites. The site provides visitor information, educational resources, employment opportunities, and park-specific content including blogs, event announcements, and volunteer programs across locations like Acadia National Park and Abraham Lincoln Birthplace National Historical Park.

## Key Topics

- National Park Service (NPS)
- Abraham Lincoln Birthplace National Historical Park
- Acadia National Park
- Knob Creek historical sites
- Educational programs and lesson plans
- Volunteer opportunities and projects
- Artist-in-residence programs
- Trail crew and park maintenance
- Seasonal hiring and employment
- Visitor planning and park ranger tips
- Historical education and primary sources
- Conservation and facility construction
- Park events and programming
- Contact information and regional offices

## Visitor Information & Planning

- [Plan Your Vacation Like a Park Ranger](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/news/plan-like-a-park-ranger.htm): Park ranger tips for planning national park visits and avoiding crowds
- [Contact Information: Mailing Addresses & Phone Numbers](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/contactinformation.htm): NPS headquarters and regional office contact directory with leadership
- [Contact Us - Abraham Lincoln Birthplace NHP](https://www.nps.gov/abli/contacts.htm): Contact information for Abraham Lincoln Birthplace NHP in Hodgenville, KY
- [Park Partial Opening - January 11, 2025](https://www.nps.gov/abli/learn/news/park-to-have-partial-opening-on-saturday-january-11-2025.htm): Winter weather closure alert for Abraham Lincoln Birthplace NHP Jan 2025

## Educational Resources & Lesson Plans

- [Shaping Lincoln Educational Videos](https://www.nps.gov/abli/learn/education/shaping-lincoln.htm): Educational videos on Lincoln's childhood, slavery views, and early life
- [Lesson Plan Three: Key Concepts & Skills](https://www.nps.gov/abli/learn/education/lesson-plan-three-key-concepts-skills-and-procedures.htm): Educational lesson plan on historical analysis and primary sources
- [Lesson Plan Four: Curriculum Standards](https://www.nps.gov/abli/learn/education/lesson-plan-four-curriculum-standards.htm): Middle school social studies curriculum standards for frontier life lessons

## Volunteer & Support Opportunities

- [Support Your Park - Abraham Lincoln Birthplace](https://www.nps.gov/abli/getinvolved/supportyourpark/index.htm): Volunteer opportunities and ways to support Abraham Lincoln Birthplace NHP
- [Volunteers Build Tool Shed at Acadia](https://www.nps.gov/acad/blogs/volunteers-build-tool-shed.htm): Volunteers construct tool shed for trail crew at Acadia National Park
- [ACE Trail Crews at Abraham Lincoln Birthplace](https://www.nps.gov/abli/learn/news/american-conservation-experience-ace-trail-crews-at-abraham-lincoln-birthplace.htm): ACE trail crews perform maintenance and accessibility improvements at park

## Employment & Onboarding

- [Seasonal Hiring: Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/seasonal-hiring-faqs.htm): NPS seasonal employment FAQs covering applications and qualifications
- [NPS Employee Onboarding](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/toolkit.htm): NPS employee onboarding and new hire process information

## Park Events & Programs

- [Shakespeare in the Parks at Abraham Lincoln Birthplace](https://www.nps.gov/abli/learn/news/shakespeare-in-the-park-visits-abraham-lincoln-birthplace.htm): Kentucky Shakespeare performs Julius Caesar at Lincoln Birthplace NHP
- [Fall Night Sky Program 2023](https://www.nps.gov/abli/learn/news/fall-night-sky-program-2023.htm): Fall 2023 astronomy stargazing event at Knob Creek Farm
- [Bluegrass Traditions Concert 2024](https://www.nps.gov/abli/learn/news/abraham-lincoln-birthplace-hosts-one-lane-bridge-for-bluegrass-traditions-concert-at-knob-creek-2024.htm): One Lane Bridge bluegrass concert at Knob Creek Tavern in 2024

## Artist-in-Residence Programs

- [Ask An Artist - Acadia National Park](https://www.nps.gov/acad/blogs/AskAnArtist.htm): Artist-in-residence program Q&A with Jennifer Booher and Sue Charles
- [Eric DeLuca - Composer in Residence](https://www.nps.gov/acad/getinvolved/air-deluca.htm): Composer Eric DeLuca's 2010 artist-in-residence project at Schoodic Point

## Optional

- [Pershing Park Settlement](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/pershing-park-settlement.htm): Legal settlement notice for Barham v Ramsey class action case
